title: Knee Replacement
description: Advanced knee replacement and reconstruction systems ensuring excellent stability, mobility, and durability.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Made of Co-Cr-Mo alloy or stainless steel, highly polished surface with friction coefficient
    extremely low.
  2. High-precision technology. All products are tested with three-dimensional measurement.
  3. Provide products of specific diameters and tapers according to clinical needs.
  4. 12/14 taper and more than 10 sizes available.

sections.html:

  2. Mechanical advantages: the bionic bone trabecular structure conforms to physiological stress distribution and can

  5. Wide range of application: applicable to IIB, IIIA, and IIIB bone defect cases that may require the use of augments.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. It is mainly used for medium-sized unilateral or bilateral non-contained bone defects, covering most bone defect filling needs.
  2. The bionic bone trabecular structure with high porosity is beneficial for bone growth and remodeling.
  3. Can be combined with a variety of XN-series knee prostheses.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. The keel wing design provides initial implantation stability.
  2. With a 5° retroversion angle, it prevents impingement with the anterior cortex.
  3. The precise and stable locking design reduces micromotion.
  4. Wide range of AP/ML options, providing better coverage of the tibial plateau.
  5. Can be combined with two types of tibial insert: PS & CR.
  6. Anatomical design of the tibial plateau, better coverage and less subsidence.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. The deep notch design at the front of the tibial insert reduces the adverse effect on the patellar ligament during high flexion.
  2. The spine is 2 mm more posterior than the normal position; the femoral condyle transverse beam contacts the spine earlier in the flexion process, reducing impact force and preventing spine fracture.
  3. The curved post prevents dislocation during high flexion.
  4. The double-plane contact area provides more stability and a lower wear rate caused by pressure.
  5. Two types: CR and PS.
  6. Multiple materials (UHMWPE/HXLPE/Vitamin E); the new Vitamin E material balances wear and mechanical properties, wear resistance, oxidation resistance, and impact resistance.

sections.label: Information
sections.html: Implant with common size differs only 1mm, which can better meet the needs of patients. The size of the Implant is dense and nearly personalized. The AP and ML sizes in the implant size are not evenly distributed to meet the needs of patients.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Safety: the depth limit sleeve adjusts the depth to avoid damaging the neurovascular bundle, making
    makes it safer and more reliable.
  2. Minimally invasive: the fixed bar is small and is used in conjunction with a 2-0 ultra-high-strength suture
    # to reduce damage to the meniscus.
  3. Convenience: 360° actively-activated one-handed fixed bar, controlling the insertion timing, making it more convenient.
  4. Multiple options: designed with 12° anterior/posterior curves and straight angles, providing more options.
  5. Comfort: based on ergonomic principles, the handle surface is designed to be non-slip, making it
    makes it more comfortable during operation.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Advanced axial design for natural joint kinematics and optimal rotational stability.
  2. Manufactured from high-strength biocompatible alloy (Co-Cr-Mo / Ti) for maximum durability.

  4. Wide range of sizes and anatomical adjustments to meet individual clinical needs.

products.title: Knee Joint Bone Cement Molding Template

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Ergonomic and precise design for uniform, accurate bone cement molding in knee procedures.
  2. Facilitates the creation of cement spacers with consistent anatomical geometry.
  3. Medical-grade non-stick material ensuring clean and efficient demolding.
  4. Multiple sizing options to accommodate diverse patient morphologies.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Flexible modular system designed for complex reconstructions and knee revision surgeries.
  2. Multiple options of stems, augments, and metaphyseal cones to address varying degrees of bone loss.
  3. Excellent mechanical stability and physiological load distribution.
  4. Secure locking mechanism reducing micromotion and optimizing osseointegration.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Minimally invasive solution for medial or lateral unicompartmental knee osteoarthritis.
  2. Preserves cruciate ligaments and healthy compartment, enabling faster recovery and natural knee kinematics.
  3. Ultra-low wear bearing surface and high-precision bone fixation.
  4. Anatomical profile ensuring excellent congruency and minimal bone resection.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Biological porous trabecular coating facilitating cementless osseointegration and biological fixation.
  2. Anatomical design replicating natural flexion and rotational kinematics of the knee joint.
  3. High biocompatibility and exceptional long-term stability for active patients.
  4. Homogeneous stress distribution to minimize stress shielding.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Temporary articulating spacer with controlled antibiotic release for two-stage knee periprosthetic joint infection treatment.
  2. Maintains joint space, range of motion, and soft tissue tension throughout the treatment period.
  3. Robust structure allowing controlled partial weight-bearing.
  4. Preformed design reducing operative time and facilitating the reimplantation procedure.

title: Hip Prosthesis
description: High-performance hip prostheses and components for primary and complex revisions, designed for maximum bone adaptation.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Osteointegration advantages: the mesh structure allows the bone to grow quickly and reliably. The micropores are interconnected. This structural feature combined with the good biocompatibility of
    titanium alloy, which further promotes bone growth.
  2. Mechanical advantages: the elastic modulus of the porous layer can reach the physiological bone level of the human body, which can make the implant replacement conform to the physiological stress distribution and reduce the shielding of
    stress as much as possible.
  3. Excellent primary stability: the outer surface is rough and the coefficient of friction with the bone bed is high, which favors the initial stability of the acetabulum and the femoral stem after implantation.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
Type A (cage with obturator hook)

  1. Suitable for use with acetabular rim defects.
  2. Indicated in situations where there is a significant bone defect in the superior sector and an iliac wing is required
    large to bridge the defect.


Type B (cage with iliac and ischial flanges)

  1. Ideal for significant acetabular defects, such as column defects or dissociation.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. The outer cup is made of cast CoCrMo alloy or stainless steel with a mirror-polished finish; the friction coefficient is extremely low.
  2. Locking structure: it is very convenient to install and effectively prevents dislocation of the small head.
  3. When revising or replacing the inner head, it is only necessary to press the locking key.
  4. The dual-center motion design ensures maximum range of motion and minimum wear of the hip joint.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Ultra-high stability: prevents dislocation and loosening of the prosthesis.
  2. Low wear rate.
  3. Large ROM, shorter hospital stay, easier revision (partial revision is possible).
  4. Higher quality of life (excellent clinical outcome) for patients after surgery.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. 1. The acetabular cup is made of titanium alloy material, and the surface features a double Ti + HA coating to ensure good bone ingrowth into the prosthesis.
  2. Optimized three-segment arc design, better implementation around the press-fit.
  3. Multiple screw holes starting from size 50, available for revision.
  4. A cup with a multi-liner design, suitable for ceramic and UHMWPE liners.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. The acetabular cup is made of Ti alloy material, and the surface has a double Ti + HA coating to ensure good bone ingrowth into the prosthesis.
  2. Optimized three-segment arc design, better implementation around the press-fit.
  3. A cup with a multi-liner design, suitable for ceramic and UHMWPE liners.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Two sizes +2 and +4 are available at the head center, which can be adjusted to the ideal head center of rotation according to the physiological and anatomical characteristics of different patients.
  2. The anti-dislocation angle can be 0°, 8°, 10°, 15°, 20°, and 30°, which can adjust the acetabular abduction angle to the ideal setting.
  3. It can increase the press-fit adjustment at the rim of the acetabular cup and screw fixation, which is beneficial for obtaining primary stability. It increases the PE liner thickness and femoral head diameter, which can improve the wear resistance of the liner, restore the center of rotation, and enhance joint stability.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Length: 150-250 mm. Straight stem: length < 200 mm. Curved stem: 200-250 mm (revision / left and right).
  2. Facilitates trochanteric reconstruction, international 12/14 taper, narrow flattened neck design, better mobility and reduced impingement.
  3. It is a multi-configuration stem.
  4. The distal hole design provides a more reliable fixation method and prevents the prosthesis from subsiding
    through the locking method.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. 12/14 taper and optimized neck shape reduce the probability of impingement, maximizing the range of motion.
  2. Longitudinal convex groove design: increases prosthesis stability, anti-rotation.
  3. Microporous titanium coating: provides a good pore space for bone growth.
  4. Short stem design: maximizes remaining bone and preserves bone for future revision.
  5. Patented curved distal end design. Facilitates implantation via anterior and anterolateral approaches, preventing thigh pain.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Suitable for revision surgery or proximal femur bone defects caused by various causes.
  2. Variety of models and sizes to choose from to best meet clinical needs.
  3. Precise and simple revision instruments facilitate complicated operations.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Two neck angles, two offsets, a total of 100 sizes. Providing more options for the patient.
  2. The internal and external grooves are designed based on the different load-bearing properties of the proximal bone
    and the prosthesis.
  3. Optimized lateral shoulder design; while retaining more bone mass, it is also suitable for
    minimally invasive surgeries.
  4. The mid-to-distal vertical rib structure increases the anti-rotation capacity of the prosthesis.
  5. Polished distal surface; the patented offset stem tip design avoids stress concentration at the distal end and reduces thigh pain.
  6. The double Ti + HA coating is beneficial for bone growth.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Universal standard 12/14 taper.
  2. Collar design: blocks the proximal medullary canal and pressurizes the bone cement.
  3. The S-line design below the neck ensures the thickness of the proximal bone cement.
  4. The highly polished proximal end reduces the shear force of the contact surface between the prosthesis and the
    bone cement and reduces debris.
  5. Equipped with a distal plug and centralizer to ensure the correct position of the stem in the medullary canal.

  3. Large ROM, shorter hospital stay, easier revision (partial revision is possible).
  4. Higher quality of life (excellent clinical outcome) for patients after surgery.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. 1. The acetabular cup is made of titanium alloy material, and the surface features a double Ti + HA coating to ensure good bone ingrowth into the prosthesis.
  2. Optimized three-segment arc design, better implementation around the press-fit.
  3. Multiple screw holes starting from size 50, available for revision.
  4. A cup with a multi-liner design, suitable for ceramic and UHMWPE liners.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. The acetabular cup is made of Ti alloy material, and the surface has a double Ti + HA coating to ensure good bone ingrowth into the prosthesis.
  2. Optimized three-segment arc design, better implementation around the press-fit.
  3. A cup with a multi-liner design, suitable for ceramic and UHMWPE liners.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Two sizes +2 and +4 are available at the head center, which can be adjusted to the ideal head center of rotation according to the physiological and anatomical characteristics of different patients.
  2. The anti-dislocation angle can be 0°, 8°, 10°, 15°, 20°, and 30°, which can adjust the acetabular abduction angle to the ideal setting.
  3. It can increase the press-fit adjustment at the rim of the acetabular cup and screw fixation, which is beneficial for obtaining primary stability. It increases the PE liner thickness and femoral head diameter, which can improve the wear resistance of the liner, restore the center of rotation, and enhance joint stability.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Length: 150-250 mm. Straight stem: length < 200 mm. Curved stem: 200-250 mm (revision / left and right).
  2. Facilitates trochanteric reconstruction, international 12/14 taper, narrow flattened neck design, better mobility and reduced impingement.
  3. It is a multi-configuration stem.
  4. The distal hole design provides a more reliable fixation method and prevents the prosthesis from subsiding
    through the locking method.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. 12/14 taper and optimized neck shape reduce the probability of impingement, maximizing the range of motion.
  2. Longitudinal convex groove design: increases prosthesis stability, anti-rotation.
  3. Microporous titanium coating: provides a good pore space for bone growth.
  4. Short stem design: maximizes remaining bone and preserves bone for future revision.
  5. Patented curved distal end design. Facilitates implantation via anterior and anterolateral approaches, preventing thigh pain.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Suitable for revision surgery or proximal femur bone defects caused by various causes.
  2. Variety of models and sizes to choose from to best meet clinical needs.
  3. Precise and simple revision instruments facilitate complicated operations.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Two neck angles, two offsets, a total of 100 sizes. Providing more options for the patient.
  2. The internal and external grooves are designed based on the different load-bearing properties of the proximal bone
    and the prosthesis.
  3. Optimized lateral shoulder design; while retaining more bone mass, it is also suitable for
    minimally invasive surgeries.
  4. The mid-to-distal vertical rib structure increases the anti-rotation capacity of the prosthesis.
  5. Polished distal surface; the patented offset stem tip design avoids stress concentration at the distal end and reduces thigh pain.
  6. The double Ti + HA coating is beneficial for bone growth.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Universal standard 12/14 taper.
  2. Collar design: blocks the proximal medullary canal and pressurizes the bone cement.
  3. The S-line design below the neck ensures the thickness of the proximal bone cement.
  4. The highly polished proximal end reduces the shear force of the contact surface between the prosthesis and the
    bone cement and reduces debris.
  5. Equipped with a distal plug and centralizer to ensure the correct position of the stem in the medullary canal.

products.title: Hip Prosthesis - Trabecular Metal Acetabular Cup (G40)

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Biomimetic trabecular metal structure providing superior osseointegration and high initial scratch fit.
  2. G40 cup configuration optimized for secure press-fit fixation in revision and complex acetabular defect cases.
  3. Multiple screw holes allowing versatile supplemental screw fixation.
  4. Fully compatible with ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) and ceramic liners.

products.title: Hip Prosthesis - Trabecular Metal Acetabular Cup (G20)

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Porous trabecular architecture mimicking human cancellous bone structure.
  2. G20 configuration featuring three polar screw holes for primary arthroplasty and maximum bone stock preservation.
  3. High friction coefficient surface eliminating immediate postoperative micro-motion.
  4. Precision taper interface accommodating multiple joint bearing liners.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Modular femoral system engineered for complex hip reconstructions, severe bone defects, and revision surgery.
  2. Allows independent adjustment of femoral anteversion, leg length, and biomechanical offset.
  3. Proximal body with biological coating and rotational stability splines.
  4. Distal fluted tapered stems crafted from high-strength titanium alloy.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Proximal metaphyseal zone featuring trabecular metal technology for accelerated biological bone ingrowth.
  2. Straight tapered wedge geometry ensuring outstanding axial and rotational primary stability.
  3. Distal longitudinal grooves minimizing stiffness and reducing stress shielding.
  4. Standard 12/14 taper compatible with metal and ceramic femoral heads.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Uncemented anatomical femoral component manufactured from medical-grade titanium alloy.
  2. Porous micro-textured surface treatment stimulating natural osteoblast migration and bone growth.
  3. Anatomical proximal contour respecting physiological femoral geometry.
  4. Proven long-term clinical performance in primary total hip arthroplasty.

products.title: Hip Joint Bone Cement Molding Mold

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Specialized non-stick medical grade silicone mold for intraoperative molding of temporary PMMA bone cement hip spacers.
  2. Preserves limb length, soft tissue tension, and joint space during two-stage management of periprosthetic joint infections.
  3. Facilitates homogeneous antibiotic incorporation into bone cement with easy release.
  4. Available in multiple head diameters and stem lengths to match patient anatomy.

title: Shoulder Prosthesis
description: Innovative solutions for the shoulder joint, high-precision implants facilitating healing and joint stability.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. The anchor is made of polyetheretherketone (PEEK) material, and the surgical field is free of metal artifacts.
  2. Complete sizing and specifications to meet surgical needs.
  3. The MB(II) type is partially double-threaded, and the MB(III) type provides a stronger fixation force for the
    double thread.
  4. Pre-load one or two high-strength sutures.
  5. The combination of pure white suture and blue-and-white suture is used to facilitate intraoperative recognition of
    sutures and knots.
  6. The inserter screw shaft features an insertion depth marker line, making the insertion process clear.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. The anchor adopts a high-low double-thread design with the same structure as the metal anchor, which can provide better fixation strength than the metal anchor.
  2. Mix and match with sutures of the same series to provide a variety of combination solutions according to the physician's needs.
  3. The anchor has excellent self-tapping performance and can be used to insert metal anchors without the
    need for pre-drilling.
  4. The anchor features an independent suture eyelet design to prevent suture tangles and knotting.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
The cable is twisted with titanium alloy wire, which offers good flexibility and prevents intraoperative fixation issues and postoperative fatigue fracture associated with single steel wires.


Compared to the traditional Kirschner wire, fixation is convenient and stable, and irritation of the
soft tissue.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Sutures are braided with ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene thread, which features minimal tissue reaction and good biocompatibility.
  2. Available in blue, white, and white-blue colors to facilitate identification and suture management during surgical procedures.
  3. Combinations of different sutures and suture needles, with complete product specifications, can satisfy various customer needs.
  4. The suture surface is smooth, uniform, knotless and non-fading, flexible, wear-resistant, with excellent knotting performance and tensile strength that far exceeds standard requirements.
  5. The suture needle is made of medical-grade stainless steel, featuring excellent material quality, good elasticity, and toughness, with a smooth needle-thread transition; the needle tail remains smooth after attachment and offers high connection strength.

title: Spine Surgery
description: High-precision solutions and implants for surgical procedures, fixation, and spine reconstruction.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Biomimetic porous tantalum structure manufactured via Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) with high interconnected porosity (75-85%).
  2. Modulus of elasticity matching cancellous bone to prevent stress shielding and subsidence.
  3. High coefficient of friction providing exceptional immediate primary stability.
  4. Promotes rapid cell adhesion, extensive vascularization, and long-term osseointegration.

products.title: Spinal Lamina Fixation Plate System (3D Printing)

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Designed via 3D additive manufacturing in medical-grade titanium alloy for expansive cervical laminoplasty.
  2. Optimized anatomical geometry providing rigid reconstruction of the decompressed spinal canal.
  3. Porous structure at bone interface zones promoting biological fusion with the lamina and lateral mass.
  4. Ultra-low profile with angled screw holes for rigid self-tapping screw fixation.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Integrated anchoring system with fixation screws/blades eliminating the mandatory need for anterior plates.
  2. Zero-profile design to prevent soft tissue irritation and postoperative dysphagia in cervical approaches.
  3. Large central grafting window to maximize bone graft volume and accelerate interbody fusion.
  4. Anti-migration teeth on superior and inferior surfaces to prevent cage expulsion.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. High-strength titanium braid providing exceptional fatigue resistance and optimal flexibility for sublaminar/subtrochanteric cerclage.
  2. Secure crimping and locking mechanism maintaining continuous tension without loosening.
  3. Compatible with complex spinal segment stabilization and reconstructive osteotomies.
  4. Superior biocompatibility and corrosion resistance under dynamic biomechanical loads.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Dynamic interspinous device designed for indirect lumbar canal and foraminal decompression.
  2. Relieves facet joint stress and restores intervertebral foraminal height.
  3. Minimally invasive insertion technique preserving the supraspinous ligament complex.
  4. Preserves segmental kinematics and reduces adjacent-level intradiscal pressures.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Engineered for corpectomy and complex spinal column reconstruction following tumors, trauma, or severe infections.
  2. 3D porous trabecular structure facilitating continuous osseointegration throughout the implant body.
  3. Anatomical endplates with aggressive anchoring teeth for maximum stability against shear and rotational forces.
  4. Comprehensive range of heights and lordotic/kyphotic angles for customized alignment.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Comprehensive polyaxial screw and rod system for occipitocervical, subaxial, and cervicothoracic junction stabilization.
  2. Broad polyaxial angulation up to 50° facilitating effortless rod alignment without anatomical strain.
  3. Lateral mass and pedicle screws featuring dual-lead thread pitch for superior pullout resistance.
  4. Transition rod connectors engineered to withstand high biomechanical bending moments.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. In-situ expandable vertebral body replacement device with continuous micrometric height restoration.
  2. Modular endplates with pivoting capability to conform to adjacent vertebral endplate contours.
  3. Generous central cavity for extensive autologous or synthetic bone graft filling.
  4. High-strength titanium alloy construction ensuring reliable immediate anterior load bearing.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Stand-alone anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF) solution with integrated locking screw fixation.
  2. Screw-locking mechanism providing tactile and visual confirmation to prevent screw backout.
  3. Anatomical shape with pre-machined lordotic angles restoring physiological sagittal cervical balance.
  4. Radiopaque tantalum markers allowing accurate intraoperative and postoperative radiographic evaluation.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Pre-bent titanium mini-plates for rigid fixation of open-door expansive cervical laminoplasty procedures.
  2. Multiple length and elevation profile options (8mm - 14mm) accommodating patient-specific decompression needs.
  3. Low-profile self-tapping mini-screws minimizing hardware prominence against surrounding soft tissue.
  4. Provides immediate and durable stabilization of the newly decompressed spinal canal.

products.title: Spinal Posterior Approach Internal Fixation System (Minimally Invasive)

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Percutaneous MIS system featuring integrated extended-tab screw heads for seamless percutaneous rod delivery.
  2. Subfascial rod insertion technique minimizing paraspinal muscle dissection and intraoperative blood loss.
  3. Cannulated polyaxial pedicle screws engineered for precise K-wire guided fluoroscopic placement.
  4. Accelerates postoperative patient recovery, significantly reducing hospital stay and postoperative pain.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Large-diameter, long-reach iliac and sacroiliac screws for robust pelvic anchoring in complex spinal deformity corrections.
  2. Ultra low-profile screw heads preventing skin irritation and palpable implant prominence over the sacral/iliac crest.
  3. Modular offset and inline connectors compatible with standard spinal rod diameters (5.5mm / 6.0mm).
  4. Engineered to withstand high biomechanical cantilever forces across the lumbosacral junction in long-segment fusions.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Cortical Bone Trajectory (CBT) pedicle screw system engineered for maximized purchase in osteoporotic bone.
  2. Dense cortical thread pitch increasing screw pullout resistance by up to 30% compared to traditional trajectories.
  3. Medialized cortical insertion point minimizing lateral paraspinal soft tissue and muscle retraction.
  4. Premier fixation strategy for short-segment lumbar fusions and patients with compromised bone mineral density.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Fenestrated pedicle screws featuring calibrated radial side ports for controlled PMMA bone cement augmentation.
  2. Homogeneous cement distribution within the vertebral body, preventing posterior leakage into the spinal canal.
  3. Ideal solution for geriatric patients, severe osteoporosis, and oncological spinal reconstructions.
  4. High-pressure injection cannula system providing leak-proof and safe cement administration.

products.title: Cervical Spine Anterior Approach Fixation System

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Ultra-thin anterior cervical plate with mirror-polished smooth contours to minimize postoperative dysphagia.
  2. Single-step integrated screw-locking mechanism providing clear visual confirmation of locked screws.
  3. Fixed and variable-angle screw options enabling tailored rigid or semi-constrained load-sharing constructs.
  4. Pre-machined lordotic curvature with expansive graft inspection windows for easy fusion monitoring.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. 3D-printed titanium alloy interbody cages featuring a porous trabecular lattice mimicking cancellous bone architecture.
  2. Nanoscale surface roughness enhancing rapid osteoblast attachment and bone growth differentiation in situ.
  3. Optimized radiographic visualization allowing distinct assessment of continuous bone bridging on CT and X-ray.
  4. Available in TLIF, PLIF, ALIF, and LLIF configurations with multiple footprints, heights, and lordotic angles.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Standard radiolucent PEEK interbody fusion cage offering biocompatible elasticity and proven clinical longevity.
  2. Modulus of elasticity closely approximating human cortical and cancellous bone, reducing subsidence rates.
  3. Embedded tantalum markers at proximal and distal extremities for precise fluoroscopic localization.
  4. Bullet-nosed anterior tip and serrated anti-migration teeth facilitating smooth distraction and secure seating.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Next-generation lumbar interbody fusion device engineered for foraminal decompression and segmental lordosis restoration.
  2. Optimized footprint maximizing endplate contact area to eliminate focal stress concentrations.
  3. Versatile compatibility with posterior, transforaminal, and lateral minimally invasive approaches.
  4. Expansive graft chamber designed to ensure robust, long-lasting 360-degree interbody bony bridging.

sections.label: Information
sections.html:
1. Patient-specific 3D-printed surgical cutting guide customized from preoperative 3D computed tomography (CT) scans.
  2. Conformal fit over unique posterior vertebral landmarks for high-precision bone resection in Smith-Petersen and PSO osteotomies.
  3. Significantly reduces intraoperative surgical time, blood loss, and fluoroscopy radiation exposure.
  4. Integrated drill sleeves ensuring safe, trajectory-guided pedicle screw pilot hole preparation in severe spinal deformities.
